preregistration_original_note: PREREG.sha256 in this repo is the original file. protocol_deviations: First draft reported Wald paired intervals; pre-registration named Newcombe/Wilson-type or bootstrap and the 0.017 Bonferroni threshold. analyze.py now uses Newcombe method 10 and reports the threshold (corrected; results/heldout_summary.json regenerated from the same per-question outputs).
